assessments.reasoning: SPDX’s pinned generated detail has licenseId OLDAP-2.7, name “Open LDAP Public License v2.7”, isDeprecatedLicenseId false, and the dated 2.7 licenseText. The crossRef and seeAlso fields cite the claimed gitweb LICENSE. CrossRef records match as the string “false”.
The unsigned v3.29.0 annotated tag in SPDX’s license-list-data repository points to commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. That commit appears in the opened OLDAP-2.7 detail URL.

The contextual OpenLDAP source is the raw LICENSE at 47c2415c1df81556eeb39be6cad458ef87c534a2. Its capture digest matches the publisher revision in scope. Its heading and three numbered paragraphs identify the named edition.

challenge.method: Test substitution of the OLDAP-2.8 detail or the SPDX matching template for the literal 2.7 licenseText and citation.
challenge.results: The literal 2.7 text gives 7 September 2001 and uses “of source code”. Its citation contains the claimed gitweb hb. The 2.8 detail instead cites an unversioned release-page path. The 2.7 template marks the heading optional, so template matching alone would lose edition evidence.

limitations: The gitweb response was not captured. The two locators and the reflowed SPDX licenseText support only the stated documentary comparison. Byte and legal equivalence remain unverified.
The finding establishes no obligations, project-wide applicability, reuse, redistribution, installation, publisher currency, or publication rights.
